reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 4 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 61 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: The Lakers have won seven straight and are coming off three days' rest. Reports on Nov 13-14 described Luka Doncic's ankle as fine and Austin Reaves' heel bruise as day-to-day with clean X-rays, so check their final status. Phoenix have won four of their last five, but there is trade noise around Jalen Green, whom rival teams think the Suns are motivated to move. If the Lakers' stars play, the angle leans towards Los Angeles.
